Makes sense, it's a tidy unit. What is it about the 40T that keeps pulling you back, the hashrate or the price?

Ran the power-cost calculator

At Queensland's ~28c a kWh, the B30 is actually the better call for you.

B30: about 43,000 sats a month, worth $36, power $83 a month. Break-even BTC price $192k.
40T: about 57,000 sats a month, worth $48, power $133 a month. Break-even $231k.

So the 40T stacks more but costs you $50 more a month to run, and needs a higher BTC price to make sense. Neither pays for itself at 28c today, it's sats plus the solo-block shot.

You picked right. Today's estimate, prices move.

Good first pick, honestly. It's quiet, it's simple to set up, and 405W won't scare your bill the way a big rig would.

When it lands, it's wifi or ethernet, a browser page for setup, and you can solo mine or point it at a pool. Shout if you want a hand configuring it then.

Thanks for the answers, and enjoy the B30 on the 30th.
